title: Boring SQL databases are winning over NoSQL and MySQL
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB take a larger share of the database conversation than MongoDB and MySQL.
expect: If true, the ratio of Postgres/SQLite/DuckDB stories to MongoDB/MySQL stories should be at least 1.4x higher in the latest 12 months than in all earlier stories since 2006 (pooled) (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: Postgres, SQLite and DuckDB per MongoDB and MySQL story

thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
